## Product snapshot
- Domain: Privacy / POPIA compliance
- Stack: Python 3.11+, stdlib HTTP server, SQLite optional state, vanilla webapp
- Entrypoints:
  - `compliancekit/pii.py`
  - `compliancekit/popia.py`
  - `webapp/server.py`
  - `webapp/index.html`
